run: vitest single fork, DB env unset, 2026-10-04

tests.test: E1 consumer, empty — a zero-row source halts with an errored FAIL gate row
E2 consumer, non-empty — a populated source yields one INFO row carrying the count
E3 array form — every named table is counted and the empty one halts

E6 emptySourceRefusal — an INGESTOR refuses only a zero-row acquisition

E8 ingest wiring — refusal runs before the pre-write gate and surfaces a supervisor row
